correctness.rationale: Smoothness and complete Hessian factorization hold over Z[1/6]. The three disjoint factor intersections give 4 hyperflexes of Hessian multiplicity 2 and 16 ordinary flexes of multiplicity 1, total 24; tangent restrictions certify the contact orders. An explicit cyclotomic unit action proves orbit decomposition and exact splitting field; finite-field Frobenius fixed-point counts follow uniformly for all p>3. Independent symbolic checks and enumerations in 23 prime fields and three quadratic extensions passed.

value.rationale: For a distinctive highly symmetric genus-three quartic, the precise inflection-point Galois representation and minimal splitting field are natural nontrivial arithmetic invariants. The six-orbit theorem yields a complete uniform finite-field count for every prime power of good characteristic and shows a universally sufficient quadratic extension. This goes beyond a trivial restatement of known complex hyperflex counts.
